reason: Conversation 2 gives the sensible first steps (turn the dial to mid, keep food off the vents), then handles the follow-up about one yoghurt still freezing well: it explains likely placement causes, suggests a thermometer, and sets clear criteria for calling an engineer (damper or thermostat fault) without naming a part or asking for the model. Conversation 1 ends before the follow-up, so it never addresses persistent freezing or escalation. It also pushes a model-number request and talks about a 'thermostat setting / dial' part when no part is needed, which is mildly off-target, though it does back down when the customer objects. Conversation 2 does slightly overstate that the yoghurt freezing is 'normal', but it hedges appropriately and is far more useful overall.
